notes.title: v1.0.26
notes.content:
☑ Update 1.0.26 is LIVE!

Friends, thank you for your patience! Here's what's new:



☑New Recruitment System
Expanded & simplified unit recruitment!  Easier to use and allows for more units (old system was limited).



☑ New Render System - "Gamma"

Smoother, sharper graphics for a better visual experience!



☑ Level 2 Balancing
Improved game economy & unit prices for a more challenging experience!



☑New Units

☑ Nashorn (Whermacht)

☑ 61KAA (AA unit) (URSS)



☑ New Polish Translation (old one sounded too mechanical)



☑ Tweaks & Bug-fixing



Update v1.0.26D

Fixed URSS - Map Brody (Menu not showing)

Addded new Level select - USA & Germany (W.I.P)









☐ A Note from Ionut:

Friends, I was out of commission for a while, spending time in the hospital. I'm doing better now and was thrilled to jump back in to finish this update!

Hope you enjoy it. Cheers!

If you have any questions, I'm online most of the time, feel free to leave a comment on the Community Hub.



☑ Thank you Gavianu for helping coding this update and this game, could not have done it without you, mate. 

Much obliged!

Greetings, Commanders!

We’re thrilled to roll out Update v1.0.24, packed with exciting new features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your battlefield experience. Here’s what’s dropping in this patch:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/68fa83b9a3da75c27ca9ddc5fab25861c6fc183c.jpg

New Features:
Paratroopers Arrive! Deploy airborne units for the US, UK, and Wehrmacht. These elite squads can parachute behind enemy lines.

☑ Paratroopers 
☐ Marine landing troops
☐ Airstrike Attack


Enhanced Audio: Fresh GUI sounds, alarms, and warning effects to keep you immersed. Plus, new audio cues for buffs and nerfs!

Interface Tooltips: Hover over abilities for clear, concise info to master your tactics.

Improvements:
Smarter AI: Upgraded pathfinding, logic, and a touch of sacrificial bravery for more challenging battles.

Performance Boost: Smoother framerates and sharper image quality for a polished experience.

Unit Balancing: Tweaked abilities and stats for fairer, fiercer fights.

Level-Up Accessibility: Units now level up more intuitively, rewarding your strategic prowess.

UI & Icon Overhaul: Cleaner, crisper interface and icons for seamless navigation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/f76ade86c2e4b7418fb48e025c154258c6e1cebf.jpg

Bug Fixes:
Squashed pesky UI glitches and map objective issues for a smoother campaign.

v1.0.24L - [Silent update]
Improved Localisations:
☑ German
☑ French
☑ Chinese
☑ Japanese
☑ Korean

Sound volume tweaks



Jump into the fray and experience the chaos of v1.0.24! Your feedback keeps the war machine rolling, so let us know your thoughts in the community hub.

Thank you, friends!

notes.title: v1.0.22
notes.content:
Game Update Patch Notes - March 27, 2025
Greetings, friends! We’ve rolled out a fresh update to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new and improved:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/24b898c2fb137d4420b33cfc711b8b854ccf76ab.jpg

✔Game Flow Enhancements: Smoother transitions and overall gameplay improvements to keep you in the action.

✔AI Pathfinding Overhaul: Smarter AI navigation with fewer hiccups—your units now move like they mean it! Plus, we’ve squashed some pesky pathfinding bugs. 
-AI no longer can occupy the same hex. 
- Fixed "ghost" units remaining on map

✔End-Turn Freeze Fix: No more player unit lockups when ending turns—your army keeps marching smoothly.

✔Map Save Fixes: The Rzhev map and BRYANSK levels now save correctly.

✔WASD Tweaks: Fine-tuned WASD controls for more responsive movement.
✔FPS Boost: Performance optimizations for a silkier frame rate.

✔Story Objectives Revamped: Resolved issues with story objectives, now properly displayed in the game pause menu.

✔UI Polish & unit tweaking, Fx not showing on some flamethrower units.


Thank you!

notes.title: v1.0.18
notes.content:
v1.0.18

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/caeea7b034bd2fc7e8d601469590f41fd573e9a6.png

**New Healing System Deployed:**
We are rolling out a strategic enhancement in the battlefield sustainment protocols: the **Automated Healing & Repair System**. 

This innovation activates at the commencement of each operational turn, ensuring your forces and assets are primed for combat.

1. **Proximity Alert:** Enemy units detected in the vicinity will compromise system effectiveness. Maintain secure perimeters for optimal recovery outcomes.

2. **Mobility Factor:** Active troop or vehicle maneuvers during the cycle will detract from the healing and repair capacity. Plan movement strategies judiciously to maximize recuperation.

3. **Combat Engagement:** Direct involvement with hostile units will severely restrict system functionality. Strategically disengage when possible to allocate repair intervals.

4. **Rapid Deplyment** Infantry & Recon can engage the same turn they are deployed.

5 **Ambush Ability** Certain units will stand guard and engage the first enemy in their LOS

6 **Rapid Fire (Initiative)** Defensive units such as Heavy MG's & Automatic canons can engage multiple times.


Improved map UI & objective highlights:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/869fe9b50552369fdb07c7ec207a8278a6f5d33b.png

Optimizations & improvements.


Thank you!
